decisions: Lane restricted strictly to buildinglab/crystal/** and buildinglab/agents/paxton/** per Part I §3.
ntfy topic stored only as sha256 fingerprint in repo; raw topic resides only in /home/user/.private/paxton.env (mode 0600).
Debian 13 Blender 4.3.2 lacks OpenImageDenoise; sc.cycles.use_denoising = False enforced across all Cycles renders (F20).
2 GB RAM doctrine enforced: all bay builds and renders run headless in isolated processes under 1,200 MB ceiling with --python-exit-code 1 (F21).
Heartbeat tooling adapted from daedalus (underworks/tools/{beat.sh,watchdog.sh,hb_daemon.sh}) and ported to Python for clean-room zero-dependency reconciliation (Appendix A).
